items.name: button
items.description: Primary, secondary, ghost and danger actions on Base UI Button, with a focusable pending state that blocks repeat submits.
items.use: Any action. Use one primary per view; a link styled as a button is still an <a>.

items.name: visually-hidden
items.description: Text for assistive technology only.
items.use: Icon-only buttons and extra context for repeated links such as 'Edit'.

items.name: field
items.description: Label, hint, Input or Textarea and error on Base UI Field; shows native and Form server errors by name.
items.use: Text inputs. Write hints that prevent errors and errors that explain the fix.

items.name: switch
items.description: Base UI switch with label and description; submits with native forms.
items.use: Settings that take effect as on/off. Use a checkbox for consent or multi-select lists.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: Labelled Base UI checkbox with hint, error and an indeterminate dash; also exports the bare CheckboxControl.
items.use: Consent and independent yes/no choices. Use a switch for settings that apply instantly.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.description: Fieldset of checkboxes answering one question, with an optional select-all parent.
items.use: Several choices that can all apply. Read the submission with formData.getAll(name).

items.name: radio-group
items.description: Fieldset of radios with per-option hints and arrow-key navigation.
items.use: One choice from five or fewer visible options. Prefer it to a select so options can be compared.

items.name: slider
items.description: Single or range slider with label, formatted value and a full-height hit area.
items.use: Approximate values and ranges such as volume or price. Use a number field when the exact number matters.

items.name: number-field
items.description: Number input with steppers, keyboard steps, label scrubbing and Intl formatting.
items.use: Exact quantities, prices and percentages. Not for phone or card numbers.

items.name: toggle-group
items.description: Pressed-state buttons for single or multiple selection, with optional hidden form inputs.
items.use: In-place modes and formatting such as alignment or list/grid view. In submitted forms prefer radios or checkboxes.

items.name: otp-field
items.description: One-time code slots that paste, autofill (one-time-code) and submit with native forms as one value.
items.use: Verification and two-factor codes. Say where the code was sent; group slots to match how the code is printed.

items.name: progress
items.description: Determinate or indeterminate progress bar for a task under way, with label and formatted value.
items.use: Uploads, exports, multi-step jobs. Pass null while progress can't be measured yet; use Meter for static measurements.

items.name: meter
items.description: A measurement within a known range, with label, formatted value and caller-chosen tone.
items.use: Storage used, quotas, password strength. Choose the tone where you know whether high is good or bad.

items.name: avatar
items.description: Photo with an initials fallback while loading or on error; alt text from the person's name.
items.use: People in lists, comments and headers. Mark decorative when the name is already shown beside it.

items.name: dialog
items.description: Modal on Base UI Dialog: focus trap, scroll lock, outside click, focus return and transitions.
items.use: Short, interrupting decisions. Prefer an inline flow when the user needs the page behind it.

items.name: tabs
items.description: Base UI tabs with keyboard navigation and a sliding indicator.
items.use: Peer views of the same object. Not for steps in a sequence or primary navigation.

items.name: disclosure
items.description: A single collapsible section on Base UI Collapsible, with animated height and find-in-page.
items.use: Secondary detail. For several related sections use accordion. Don't hide content most users need.

items.name: callout
items.description: Info, success, warning and danger messages with optional live announcement.
items.use: Feedback after an action and important context. Say what happened and what to do next.

items.name: empty-state
items.description: Title, reason and next action for a screen with nothing to show yet.
items.use: First runs, filters with no matches and failed loads; each needs its own words.

items.name: select
items.description: Listbox select on Base UI: typeahead, aligned popup, scroll arrows and native form submission.
items.use: Short lists of fixed choices. Switch to combobox once people would rather type than scroll.

items.name: combobox
items.description: Filterable select on Base UI with clear button, empty message and native form submission.
items.use: Long lists of fixed choices, such as countries or teammates. Not for free-text search.

items.name: menu
items.description: Dropdown menu with items, links, separators, labelled groups, checkbox and radio items, and submenus.
items.use: Secondary actions on an object. Keep the primary action visible; don't hide navigation in it.

items.name: context-menu
items.description: Right-click and long-press menu for an area, built from the menu item's parts.
items.use: Shortcuts only. Every action must also be reachable from visible controls.

items.name: popover
items.description: Non-modal panel anchored to a trigger, with optional title, description, close button and hover opening.
items.use: Details, small forms and infotips. Use a dialog when the user must decide before continuing.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: Visual label on hover and focus, plus a provider so neighbouring tooltips open instantly.
items.use: Labels for icon-only buttons. Never essential content: it doesn't show on touch.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.description: Confirmation that can't be dismissed by clicking outside, with focus on Cancel, async confirm and in-dialog errors.
items.use: Destructive or irreversible actions. For reversible ones, act immediately and offer undo in a toast.

items.name: drawer
items.description: Edge panel (right, left or bottom sheet) with swipe-to-dismiss, backdrop and focus management.
items.use: Secondary tasks that keep the page's context, and mobile menus. Use dialog when you don't need gestures.

items.name: toast
items.description: Stacked, swipeable notifications with tones, an action button and loading/success/error from a promise.
items.use: Confirming background work and offering undo. Not for errors the user must fix in place; use a field error or callout.

items.name: accordion
items.description: Collapsible sections with animated height, single or multiple open, searchable with find-in-page.
items.use: FAQs and grouped secondary detail. Use Disclosure for a single section that must work without JavaScript.

items.name: scroll-area
items.description: Scroll container with a slim themed scrollbar and edge fades that show where content is hidden.
items.use: Bounded lists and panels inside a page. Prefer page scroll; nest scrolling only when it helps.

items.name: settings-flow
items.description: A /settings route with a Server Action, Base UI Form errors per field, an error summary, saved and pending states.
items.use: Starting point for any form that saves data. Shows the states a form needs before it's done.
